title: Targeted verify runs the tests that exercise changed modules
body:
Outcome: krn verify's targeted stage also runs every test file that exercises a changed module through the CLI (e.g. test/worker/* for src/worker/*), so a change to a persisted record shape fails locally instead of in krn/gate.
Source: PR #183 head ff2d8ef passed krn verify but krn/gate failed on test/worker/scope-bypass.test.ts:204 (inbox record deep-equal); found only by a 10-minute full local npm test (.krn/runs/lead/worker-compaction/local-test.txt).
